source_notes.collection: Uses the existing Borean foundation objective classification. Positive tags require real item objectives, trusted drop/pickup mechanics, at least two trusted item units, and trusted count confidence; direct object interactions and single-item objectives are excluded.
source_notes.chain: Scope-aware follow-up facts combine forward Questie links and reverse prerequisite dependencies inside the confirmed Borean + Dragonblight route horizon.
source_notes.timing: Task-intrinsic service estimates only; route movement and hub handling remain route-layer costs. Unsupported mechanisms are tagged unknown rather than receiving a fake generic fallback.
source_notes.scope: This output is task-card/base-data only. Optimization decisions such as keep/skip/removal priority are intentionally excluded.
